rationale: Use the fastest measured correct source as the integration base. Replace its SSE2 high-bit classification (`_mm_cmpgt_epi8(zero, value)` followed by movemask) with direct `_mm_movemask_epi8(value)`, which extracts the same byte sign bits without the packed comparison. Preserve the existing UTF-8 masks, carry and restricted-byte checks, bounded scalar tail, fallback, and ABI. Do not merge the slower ASCII-prefix or word-scan variants; measure this focused change and retain the base if it does not improve.
